Alright
Sep 2018 • Friends
Sushi Be was one of the the top things I wanted to do while in Da Nang, as many of my friends (especially ones living in there) have recommended it to me, knowing how much I love sushi and sake.

Their location on Nguyen Chi Thanh is new, and the interior looks very nice.

I ordered the 10 piece nigiri set, and it came out all at the same time on one plate. I was able to immediately identify 7 of the pieces, so I asked the waitress what kind of fish/seafood I was being served. Unfortunately, she was only able to explain what 5 of the 10 pieces were.

Regardless, I ate my meal. Although I enjoyed a couple of the nigiri, such as tai and anago, I thought much of the rest was on par to other higher end sushi restaurants in Vietnam. I also believe the sushi rice is just as important as the fish, but the shari here was nothing exceptional.

While not a bad meal, I was a bit let down by the high expectations.

Best sushi bar in Danang
May 2018 • Friends
I'm a big fan of sushi and sushi Be is one of my favorites. A few friends of mine recommended this restaurant and it was actually over my expectation. Though the restaurant is small but it's very cozy with Japanese style. You even can feel it from the outside through a small main entrance. The sushi and sashimi here are very tasty and fresh, especially the squid. I also like the roll with beef since they knows how to cook the beef that full of flavor but not losing the texture of the beef. They also have set menu for someone who would like to try Japanese fine-dining with reasonable prices. Highly recommend this restaurant and definitely will come back to have the freshest sashimi in town.
